author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Fence lifecycle cleanup and latch clock-fault notifications
details: Prevent synchronous disconnect/UI cleanup callbacks from recursively invalidating or reconnecting. Record earlier Apple build evidence with exact pinned source limits and preserve remaining transport, clock and paired-device acceptance gates.
validation: 12 portable Swift 6.0.3 Linux tests passed with complete strict concurrency and warnings as errors; 3 Python consumer expiry/reconnect tests passed. No current-head Apple SDK or physical test claimed.
